gpu_contract.entry: run_plans(selected: Option<usize>, plans: &[(&str, &[u32], &Plan)], on_pass: FnMut(&str, &Plan, &[u32]) -> Result<()>) -> Result<()>
ordering: Reject more than 30 plans, or selected Some with no plans, before instance creation.
Start one 20-second run deadline before Vulkan enumeration.
Create display-handle-free Vulkan-only instance; require compiled and returned backend Vulkan.
Enumerate 1..16 adapters, print complete ordered ADAPTER inventory before selection error or rendering.
selected None returns after inventory; selected Some selects checked index and requests device with empty features/downlevel defaults.
Push Validation, OutOfMemory, Internal error scopes before layouts/pipelines.
Build rectangle and image pipelines; only build glyph pipeline if a submitted plan has glyphs.
Each plan validates exact GPU allocation ledger and expected full-frame length, then executes ordered separate compute passes, copies to readback, waits, and compares every u32.
Invoke on_pass only after successful frame comparison; stop first raster/callback failure.
Pop error scopes in Internal, OutOfMemory, Validation order even after collected raster/callback failure; scope/wait errors precede saved outcome.

deadlines.checkpoints: Enumeration/request-device futures; each plan and draw; device.poll, mapping callback, and each error-scope pop. Outer process timeout remains responsible for a synchronously blocking driver call.

storage_and_output: Output STORAGE|COPY_SRC has no COPY_DST: CPU reference is never uploaded as output.
Readback COPY_DST|MAP_READ; parameter UNIFORM|COPY_DST; optional source STORAGE|COPY_DST, allocated only for nonempty input.
Each draw uses dynamic 256-byte parameter slot; rectangle uniform size32, image/glyph size64; device alignment must divide256.
One compute pass per draw preserves source-over order; workgroups 8x8 as immutable Plan.
Exact full-frame little-endian readback, including zero high byte expected values; mismatch reports first pixel coordinate and values.
Readback unmapped and normal comparison-path buffers explicitly destroyed.
Errors are failures, never CPU fallback. Callback is bounded synchronous output.

protocol.adapter: ADAPTER {i} vendor={:#x} device={:#x} type={:?} backend={:?} name={:?} driver={:?} info={:?}
protocol.standalone_pass: PASS {} {}x{} draws={} invocations={} gpu_buffers={} compared_bytes={} exact=true
protocol.failure: stderr FAIL {e}, unsuccessful ExitCode; no COMPLETE on error
protocol.wrapper_requirement: If printing/comparison move out of reusable core, preserve all observable wrapper line contents/order/counts, original plan/expected identity, callback and error-scope semantics, and bounded waits.
